about.summary: Software Engineer with 6+ years building scalable microservices and backend platforms. Skilled in designing and delivering RESTful and gRPC APIs in Go and Java, applying clean architecture, observability, and performance optimization. Hands-on with secure identity and access (JWT, Ory Kratos/Hydra), payments (QRIS), and dashboards using Next.js. Collaborative, outcomes-driven, and agile—translating business needs into reliable, maintainable systems.
